Modal Labs, Inc. is an American software infrastructure company. The company provides a serverless cloud computing platform that makes it easy to deploy and develop machine learning models and other compute-heavy applications.
History
Modal Labs was founded in 2021 by Erik Bernhardsson (former CTO at Better.com and creator of Spotify's music recommendation system) and Akshat Bubna (former engineering lead at Scale AI). Both Bernhardsson and Bubna come from competitive programming backgrounds. The company raised a $7 million seed round in early 2022.
In 2023, Modal Labs secured $16 million in Series A funding led by Redpoint Ventures, with participation from Amplify Partners, Lux Capital and Definition Capital.
The company is headquartered in New York City with offices in Stockholm and San Francisco.
Features
Modal Labs offers a platform with several key features:
* Python SDK: Modal provides a Python SDK. Users write Python functions that when decorated with Modal annotations, run in the cloud.
* Serverless Execution Environment: The platform automatically scales from zero to thousands of containers based on workload demands.
* GPU Access: On-demand access to Nvidia GPUs including H100s, A100s, L4s, and T4s with per-second billing.
* Observability: Built-in logging, monitoring, and debugging tools for tracking execution and performance.
Use Cases
Common use cases for Modal's platform include:
* AI Inference (serving LLMs, image generators, video and audio models)
* AI Fine-tuning
* Large-scale data processing
* Running untrusted code
Privacy and Security
Modal Labs is SOC2 Type I, Type II, and HIPAA compliant.
Community and Adoption
Notable organizations using Modal include Suno AI, Cursor, Substack, Ramp, and Quora.
